subject: Add 4 commands for sentinel and update most test cases and json files (#789)
reason: The change only adds alias subcommand names (SENTINEL PRIMARIES/PRIMARY/IS-PRIMARY-DOWN-BY-ADDR/GET-PRIMARY-ADDR-BY-NAME) inside sentinelCommand plus command-table/JSON metadata and Sentinel TCL test renames; the old MASTER* spellings keep working, so no existing behaviour changes. Every SENTINEL subcommand is CMD_ONLY_SENTINEL (src/server.c:2965), registered only when the process runs in sentinel mode, which is entered solely via the executable name 'valkey-sentinel' or the --sentinel argv flag (src/server.c:6401-6410) and cannot be enabled by any config directive.
